gui.modminds.panel.hint: Click a button to trigger it · hover to read what it does
gui.modminds.panel.help.lighting: A lightning flash over every player. Visual only.
gui.modminds.panel.help.gray_screen: Grey curtain over every player's screen until cleared.
gui.modminds.panel.help.red_screen: Red screen over every player until cleared.
gui.modminds.panel.help.clear_screen: Takes the screen overlays off every player.
gui.modminds.panel.help.ghost: Spawns red ghosts. The box below sets how many.
gui.modminds.panel.help.nereids: Spawns Nereids. The box below sets how many.
gui.modminds.panel.help.piglins: Spawns Limbo Piglins. The box below sets how many.
gui.modminds.panel.help.mount_boss: Ride the boss and steer where it looks.
gui.modminds.panel.help.reviil_explode: Nine rings of charges run out from Reviil to fifty blocks, each one traced on the ground it detonates on.
gui.modminds.panel.help.reviil_shot: Draws the roulette out of his hip and lets a volley of darts fly at one target.
gui.modminds.panel.help.agarre: Grab: takes one player by the hand, lifts them up and drops them back into the floor with the totem popping. Out of reach is the only dodge.
gui.modminds.panel.help.escena: Scene: Reviil puts the mace down and delivers his monologue, with his own voice, subtitles and gestures. Three minutes, no damage on anybody.
gui.modminds.panel.help.golpe_suelo: Ground pound: the floor under him is painted red and the sand starts lifting, then both fists come down and the whole circle goes up at once, leaving fissures behind.
gui.modminds.panel.help.reviil_furia: Fury: he beats his own chest and stamps the floor, his glow turns red and the fight keeps going with him faster and every swing landing half again as hard. It comes on by itself once he is under a third of his health.
gui.modminds.panel.help.reviil_gigante: Giant: he grows half again as tall in one breath and stops walking on his own. From that spot he fires his own area attacks without waiting for the panel, at a weight the floor was not built for. Shrink takes it back off.
gui.modminds.panel.help.reviil_encoge: Shrink: he gives the size back and returns to whichever phase he grew out of. The giant attacks stop answering him, the floor is no longer being leaned on and he walks again. Whoever he was holding in his fist is set down on the ground unhurt.
gui.modminds.panel.help.soldados: Soldados: four of his subjects climb out of the sand spread across the arena. They carry a sword that takes four hearts off a full bar and they come for whoever stands nearest.
gui.modminds.panel.help.puno_marcado: Marked fist: he paints a red circle on the floor under his target and the fist lands inside it. If it closes on you, hammer the space key to work his fingers loose; if you do not, he drives the fist back into the sand with you in it.
gui.modminds.panel.help.ruleta_gigante: Giant roulette: three spins, and each one fires a different one of his giant-phase attacks without repeating the same attack twice. Nothing else comes out of him while the wheel is turning.
gui.modminds.panel.help.arrastrar_mano: Dragged hand: he plants his palm at one end of the arena and drags it the whole length of the lane he painted. Only the slice of line he has just covered cuts you, so stepping out of the lane is a real dodge.
gui.modminds.panel.help.aplauso: Applause: three claps, and the last one burns the screen white and rings your ears for a few seconds. It breaks no blocks and kills nobody; it leaves you blind in the middle of the fight.
gui.modminds.panel.help.sal: The salt: he takes up a handful and scatters it over the whole arena the way you salt a meal. They are meteors: they do not touch the floor, they only fall on the players.
gui.modminds.panel.help.agujero_negro: Black hole: he opens a hole in the arena that drags in anyone who walks near it and then throws them back out against the floor.
gui.modminds.panel.help.circulos_rayos: Lightning circles: six seals tear open in the floor and discharge upward together. The bolts are his and not Minecraft's: they are painted before they fall and they land where they were painted.
gui.modminds.panel.help.bloques_alzandos: Rising blocks: he presses both hands into the sand and columns lift out of it across the whole circle, one after another. They are drawn, not placed: when he lets go the floor is the same floor.
gui.modminds.panel.help.avalancha: Avalanche: he shoves with both arms and a wave of mountain blocks runs the length of the arena. Caught from the front it carries you; from the side it can be stepped out of.
gui.modminds.panel.help.campo_rojo: Red field: he grips one arm with the other, lifts both fists over his head and brings them down together. The ground opens into an enormous red field that burns anyone still standing inside it.
gui.modminds.panel.help.reviil_embestida: Charge: he drops onto his shoulder, takes aim at you and runs three passes in a row, each one faster, along a lane he paints a moment before he goes. At the end he is left leaning on the arena.
gui.modminds.panel.help.zarpazo: Rake: he coils with the claw over his shoulder, paints three lanes across the floor in front of him and throws three passes into them - two that cut and push you out of the line, and a last one thrown level with your head that puts you in the air. Backing out of the fan is the whole dodge; it only reaches as far as his own arm.
gui.modminds.panel.help.orbita: Reviil holds its pose while the marked ground comes down like a mace.
gui.modminds.panel.help.rayo_vacio: Void ray: the lane is traced in red, then swept through 120 degrees.
gui.modminds.panel.help.aullido: Howl: the arena rings in red, then a 26-block shockwave blinds and slows.
gui.modminds.panel.help.lluvia: Void rain: twelve meteors fall around the target and drift with it.
gui.modminds.panel.help.ruleta: Lethal roulette: five rings of darts, each turned half a step further.
gui.modminds.panel.help.croupier: The croupier's finisher: the wheel decides which of four attacks lands.
gui.modminds.panel.help.tormenta: Steel storm: Reviil throws himself down a painted lane, shedding darts behind him.
gui.modminds.panel.help.corona: Void crown: sigils orbit Reviil, then fly out when the crown breaks.
gui.modminds.panel.help.scream: Scream: slams the ground and fogs every screen.
gui.modminds.panel.help.hydra_beam: Rayo: a beam out of the Hydra that damages whatever it crosses.
gui.modminds.panel.help.area_attack: Area attack: a red circle marks where the blast will land.
gui.modminds.panel.help.water_charge: Water charge: a lobbed splash that leaves damaging pools, three at a time.
gui.modminds.panel.help.marea: Abyssal tide: three crests run outward and throw whoever they touch.
gui.modminds.panel.help.mordida: Triple bite: three head slams, each closing where you stand when it opens.
gui.modminds.panel.help.abismo: Abyss: the sea rises around the Hydra for seven seconds, slowing and drowning.
gui.modminds.panel.help.chorro: Jets: the neck turns three times, spraying well past its own warning circle.
gui.modminds.panel.help.terra_punch: Terra punch: the fist hits the floor and detonates it under nearby players.
gui.modminds.panel.help.ultimate_jump: Ultimate jump: the Titan leaps and explodes where it lands.
gui.modminds.panel.help.roll: Roll: the Titan stalls, then rolls forward for ten seconds.
gui.modminds.panel.help.titan_punch: Punch: a hammer blow that detonates where it lands.
gui.modminds.panel.help.quiebra: Floor collapse: the ground opens along the line it faces, then again at ninety degrees.
gui.modminds.panel.help.corral: Stone corral: pillars erupt in a ring that keeps shrinking around its prey.
gui.modminds.panel.help.muro: Ash wall: lit lanes travel outward from the Titan. Stand out of them.
gui.modminds.panel.help.suelo: Limbo floor: the ground pulses under the Titan, slowing and levitating anyone inside.
gui.modminds.panel.help.bola_fuego: Fireball: a rolling ball of fire runs forty blocks along the ground and breaks apart.
gui.modminds.panel.help.sierra: Saw: the arm sweeps a one-hundred-and-sixty degree cut along the line it points at.
gui.modminds.panel.help.meteoro: Triple meteor: three hops, each one landing inside a shrinking marked circle.
gui.modminds.panel.off_phase: not the body he is wearing right now
gui.modminds.panel.off_phase_here: This is not the body he is wearing right now:
gui.modminds.panel.readout.empty: Point at a button and what it does is written here, in full.
gui.modminds.panel.readout.nav: Change tab: click, Page Up/Down or 1-7
gui.modminds.panel.no_boss_near: No boss of that kind within reach
gui.modminds.panel.help.drop_target: The boss forgets everybody and stops fighting.
gui.modminds.panel.help.mount_tiki: Ride the Tiki Guardian. Its charge still fires from the saddle, aimed where you look.
gui.modminds.panel.help.embestida: Charge: the idol ducks for a moment, then runs straight along the direction it was locked to.
gui.modminds.panel.help.espinas: Thorns: five rings of floor darts, each one drawn where you stood when it opened.
gui.modminds.panel.help.furia: Fury: a fan of darts at range, a ring in every direction up close.
gui.modminds.panel.help.guardianes: Turrets: three dart turrets climb out of the floor, one every twelve ticks, and rot in half a minute.
gui.modminds.panel.help.tiki_escena: Scene: the Tiki Guardian beats its own belly like a drum and says what it is, with its voice and subtitles. Nobody takes damage while it runs.
gui.modminds.panel.help.pulso: Pulse shot: the next one lands immediately instead of on its own beat. Needs a target.
gui.modminds.panel.help.picado: Dive: the Coloso throws itself down the line its head points at.
gui.modminds.panel.help.petrificar: Petrify: the gaze freezes everyone within twenty blocks for five seconds.
gui.modminds.panel.help.detonar: Detonate: the bomb breaks on the closest player, blinding them and dropping a wingless one on their head.
gui.modminds.panel.help.pared_x: Barrier: fills the air in the 51-block box around the Orb, swept along X.
gui.modminds.panel.help.pared_z: Barrier: the same box, swept along Z.
gui.modminds.panel.help.quitar_paredes: Turns both boxes of barrier back into air.
gui.modminds.panel.help.summon_orbs: Summons the mob typed below beside every Orb within five blocks and opens their spawners.
gui.modminds.panel.help.reactor_summon: Six of these, in a ring around every Reactor Hydra within 150 blocks.
